_comment: Rule-based 'AI rating'. Owned by the finance team. The code blends the methods below into a fair value per share, then compares it with the share price. The AI never chooses the rating; it only explains it.

thresholds._note: Buy if fair value is at least 15% above the price, Sell if at least 10% below, otherwise Hold.

weights._note: Weights are renormalised over the methods available for a company. Analyst targets and the 52-week range are shown for context only and never enter the rating; the Monte Carlo is the same model as the DCF, so it is not counted twice.

_outlier_note: A method whose value is more than 50% away from the median of all methods is excluded as an outlier.

confidence._note: Spread of the included methods (coefficient of variation): <= 15% with 3+ methods = high, <= 30% = medium, else low.

overall._note: Page-1 overall view (shown next to the AI rating, never replaces it). Scores: Sell 1, Underperform 2, Hold 3, Outperform 4, Buy 5 (model Buy/Hold/Sell = 5/3/1). Each broker's latest rating counts if at most fresh_days old: fully up to full_weight_days, older_weight after that. The model counts model_weight, the brokers the rest; with fewer than min_brokers recent brokers their share shrinks in proportion. Model not rated -> brokers only.
